#!/usr/bin/env bash
R="/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-gh-runner/_work/cap-evolve/cap-evolve/ci/benchmarks/.work/suite_full_tau2_proj/.capevolve/run_suite"
LOG="$R/work/logs/round1.log"
while true; do
  cn=$(find "$R/rollouts" -name '*ctl_null*' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  c1=$(find "$R/rollouts" -name '*cand1*' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  stage=$(grep -E "exit=|COMPLETE" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
  err=$(grep -m1 -hE "ModuleNotFound|Traceback|Error:" "$R"/work/logs/eval_ctl_null.err "$R"/work/logs/eval_cand1.err 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  echo "ctl_null=$cn/500 cand1=$c1/500 | $stage | $err"
  grep -q "COMPLETE" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null && break
  sleep 120
done
echo "ROUND1 MONITOR DONE"
